name: Nevada
permitAge: 15 and a half (instruction permit); driver education not required for the permit

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, logged on form DLD-130 (100 hours, 10 at night, if no driver education school within 30 miles and no internet access)
teen.holdPermit: 6 months (applicants under 18), and 6 months free of at-fault crashes and moving violations
teen.nightLimit: Drivers under 18: no driving 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. unless going to or from a scheduled event, until age 18 (handbook p. 15)
teen.passengerLimit: Licensed at 16 or 17: first six months, no passengers under 18 except immediate family (NRS 483.2523, handbook p. 15)
teen.phone: All drivers: no handheld phone for calls (hands-free allowed), no texting or internet use (handbook p. 43, NRS 484B.165). Fines $50 / $100 / $250 within seven years; extra penalty in work and school zones.

notes: Checked 2026-10-09 against the Nevada Driver Handbook, DMV 700, March 2024 edition (PDF created June 2023, modified March 2024). Printed page numbers match PDF page numbers.
Permit valid one year. Supervisor: licensed, at least 21, licensed at least one year, seated next to the beginner. Parent or guardian signs a financial responsibility statement.
Under-21 0.02 to 0.08: NRS 483.461 and form DP-038 say 90-day suspension; the handbook says 185-day revocation. Conflict, not used in questions.
Move over (NDOT): slow down and move to the far lane when possible for stopped emergency vehicles with lights; extended to NDOT vehicles and, from Oct. 1, 2017, any traffic incident.
School bus: on a highway divided by a physical barrier or dividing section, traffic on the other roadway need not stop (NRS 484B).
Maximum posted speed 80 mph on state highways (NRS 484B.613).

Knowledge test (dmv.nv.gov/wtestteens.htm): 25 multiple-choice questions, 80 percent (20 correct); 60-minute limit online, no limit in person; results valid one year. Online test in English and Spanish; in-office test in English, Spanish and audio. Handbook p. 12: Class C test also in Spanish; oral exam on request. Applicants lacking English or Spanish may use an approved interpreter.
The claim that the test stops after 6 wrong answers was not found on any official page; nv-012 stays medium.
Under-21 0.02 to 0.08: handbook p. 79 says suspended, p. 80 and p. 13 say revoked 185 days; NRS 483.461/DP-038 say 90-day suspension. Not used in questions.
Spanish audio handbook exists (DMV news); no official Spanish PDF handbook URL found.
